Simulate steady-state, two-phase oil-water flow in a horizontal pipe using twoPhaseEulerFoam.
Use a pipe diameter of 0.1 m and a pipe length of 5 m.
Set the inlet fixed mixture velocity to 1 m/s.
Set the inlet water volume fraction alpha.water to a fixed value of 0.3.
Set the outlet boundary condition for alpha.water to zeroGradient.
Set the outlet boundary condition for the velocity to zeroGradient or an appropriate outlet condition for twoPhaseEulerFoam.
Set the pipe walls to noSlip for both phases.
Run the simulation until a steady-state solution is achieved.
